Container.Name: yt-simple-download
Container.Overview: A tiny, private YouTube downloader. Paste a link, choose Audio (mp3) or Video (mkv) and a quality, hit Download, and the finished file streams to your phone or PC. All-in-one container (web + queue + worker + yt-dlp + ffmpeg + Deno). Storage is ephemeral and self-cleaning. Single videos only (playlists are rejected). Basic auth is enabled by default via APP_USER / APP_PASSWORD — clear BOTH to disable it (e.g. when fronted by Cloudflare + Google SSO).
Container.Description: Private, self-hosted YouTube downloader with a one-screen web UI. mp3/mkv, quality selector, live progress, and direct-to-device download.

Config.Name: Downloads (temp)
Config.Description: Ephemeral working dir. Purged on start; swept after RETENTION_HOURS.

Config.Name: Config (cookies)
Config.Description: Optional. Put a Netscape cookies.txt here and set YT_COOKIES to use it.

Config.Name: APP_USER
Config.Description: Basic-auth username. Clear this AND APP_PASSWORD to disable auth.

Config.Name: APP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Basic-auth password. Change this. Clear it (and APP_USER) to disable auth.

Config.Name: RETENTION_HOURS
Config.Description: Delete finished files this many hours after creation.

Config.Name: YT_COOKIES
Config.Description: Optional path to a mounted cookies.txt, e.g. /config/cookies.txt

Config.Name: EXTRA_YTDLP_ARGS
Config.Description: Optional extra yt-dlp CLI args, e.g. --limit-rate 5M
